title: Getting started
caption: Left: the old way, printing huge runs in advance and picking copies by hand. Right: the new way, printing just what each child needs that week as one book.
intro: HaruBook changes how workbooks are made. Instead of printing huge runs in advance and having people pick copies for each student, we print only what each student needs that week, bound as one book for that one student. Let's follow one student from sign-up until the book is in their hands, running the real system.

title: New student sign-up
caption: A home-visit teacher signs up a new student. Choosing the teacher sets the branch, region and delivery route.
intro: A new student signs up. We set only the name, the subjects, the starting issue, and the assigned teacher.
after: Choosing the teacher instantly links the branch, region, and delivery route in one chain. That chain becomes the print order.

title: Individual progress
caption: Even in the same grade, progress differs by subject. Teachers adjust it before the cutoff.
intro: Each student has a next issue and a weekly pace for every subject. Before the order cutoff, the teacher can adjust progress, such as review, skip, or pause, and every change is logged.

title: Workbook content
caption: Content arrives as one PDF per issue. Pages are pulled by number when each book is built.
intro: Workbook content arrives as one PDF per issue. There's no need to split it into pages in advance; pages are pulled by number when each book is built.
after: The content is attached. On upload, the page size and fonts are checked automatically, and the page count follows the file.

title: Cutoff: orders fixed, codes assigned
caption: Orders close at a set time. Each student's book for the week is fixed by their progress at that moment.
intro: At a set time, orders close. We call this the cutoff. Every student's book for the week is fixed according to their progress at that moment.
after: Several subjects are combined into one book, and each book gets a unique code. Printed as a QR code, it is read at every step, from the factory to the student's hands.

title: Production plan: print order is sort order
caption: Sorted by route, branch, teacher, visit day, then student. This order is the sorting order.
intro: Now we set the print order: delivery route, branch, teacher, visit day, then student.
after: Printed in this order, each teacher's books come out together. No re-sorting is needed; just cut the stream wherever the teacher changes.

title: Print files
caption: A cover-and-content PDF is made for each student and laid out on the paper roll with trim marks.
intro: A print file with cover and content is generated for each student. It's laid out on the paper roll with trim marks, and every page carries a small code, so a missing or mixed-up sheet is caught right away.

title: Printing and binding check
caption: A roll press prints, a saddle stitcher binds, and a camera reads each book's QR code to catch missing books.
intro: We print, saddle-stitch, and scan each book's QR code for inspection.
after: If a book is missing from the print sequence, a warning appears on the spot. Defective books are reprinted and returned to the same place in the bundle.

title: Teacher bundle, branch box, route truck
caption: Books are cut into teacher bundles in print order, boxed per branch and loaded per route. Every step is scanned.
intro: Books go into teacher bundles, bundles into branch boxes, and boxes onto route trucks. Every step is scanned.
after: Try to put another teacher's book in a bundle, or an unfinished bundle in a box, and the scan is rejected. Mistakes are stopped where they happen.

title: Branch receipt, teacher pickup, delivery
caption: The teacher picks up the bundle at the branch and hands each child their own book at the home visit.
intro: The branch receives the box, the teacher picks up their bundle, and hands each book to the student at the home visit.
after: With a single code, anyone can see where a book has been and where it is now.

title: Lesson check: was it finished?
caption: At the next visit, the teacher records whether last week's book was finished. That decides the next book.
intro: At the next visit, the teacher records whether last week's book was finished. This time, let's record that math was only half done.
after: Math won't be printed next week. New workbooks don't pile up on top of unfinished ones.

title: Next cutoff: delayed subjects wait
caption: A subject that wasn't finished is not printed next week.
intro: A week later, it's the next cutoff.
after: Math, marked as delayed, is left out, and only the other subjects ship. It isn't skipped; it just rests for a week.

title: Picking up again
caption: A subject that rested for a week continues from the issue where it stopped.
after: Math picks up again from the issue where it stopped. If books pile up for more than two weeks with no lesson check, production also pauses automatically.

title: Graded photos: no sorting needed
caption: Upload a photo of a graded page, and the page's QR code tells whose book and which page it is.
intro: The teacher takes a photo of a graded page with a phone.
after: From the QR code on each page, the system knows whose book and which page it is, and files it automatically. Wrong answers are collected and later printed together at the back of that student's book.

title: Summary
caption: From sign-up to the child's hands, and lesson results feeding the next book: one full cycle.
intro: To sum up. Choose the teacher, and the delivery path is set. Print only that week's work as one book, following each student's progress, and the print order is the sorting order. Every step is tracked book by book, and lesson results feed into the next workbook. Thank you.
